title: TimeChorus axial rule set
description: Generated from the columns in axial data/csv/ and the rules in axial tools/validate.py. Behaviour-preserving as of ENGINE_VERSION 0.1.0: the generalised validator reproduces the axial validator's output byte for byte. v2.1 (r6-0, 2026-09-25): the five schema-v2-boundary columns land (people.map_place_id + map_place_basis, events.note, passages.original_source_id, places.source_ids, sources.credit_clause), all empty on landing; schemaVersion stays "2" (schema/v2's directory name and pick_schema_dir's v\d+ match do not admit a dotted directory) -- "v2.1" is this round's own label for the addition, recorded here, not a second schema/ directory. v2.2 (r9-2, 2026-10-04): people.map_place_reason lands (the reader-register reason behind map_place_id; map_place_basis stays the reviewers' working log), empty on landing, label recorded the same way.
